observed_mechanisms.observation: LangGraph exposes a configurable recursion_limit with a dedicated GraphRecursionError when the maximum graph-step budget is exhausted. The default is injected through runtime configuration rather than inferred from model behavior.
observed_mechanisms.reason: WP509 already has explicit max_iterations and remaining_work_units, so the hard-budget idea is not a missing primitive.

observed_mechanisms.observation: RemainingSteps is a managed read-only value computed as stop minus current step; IsLastStep is similarly derived from execution scratchpad rather than model text.
observed_mechanisms.reason: F2 has a remaining_work_units input but no evidenced runtime-managed, provenance-bound remaining-budget view exposed to cognition/policy. A derived read-only budget view could reduce self-estimated budget drift without creating new state authority.

observed_mechanisms.observation: The prebuilt agent checks remaining_steps before allowing further tool-call progression; with too few steps it substitutes a terminal assistant message instead of proceeding into a tool cycle.
observed_mechanisms.reason: The pre-call resource gate is useful, but F2 must not copy the natural-language fallback or let an assistant message become control/completion authority. The transferable mechanism is a deterministic typed pre-dispatch budget gate.

observed_mechanisms.observation: RunControl provides a run-scoped cooperative drain request, while GraphDrained is documented as an early graph exit at a superstep boundary with checkpoint save/resume semantics.
observed_mechanisms.reason: F2 WP509 already distinguishes typed exits from completion; a resumable drain/HOLD transition is structurally aligned and can make resource/shutdown stops explicit without destroying work or minting COMPLETE.

negative_evidence_and_transfer_limits.finding: The langgraph package is a stateful orchestration framework with its own graph runtime, checkpoint package, SDK, prebuilt agent layer, configuration and persistence abstractions.
negative_evidence_and_transfer_limits.f2_consequence: Do not import LangGraph as the WP509 control plane. That would add a competing orchestration/checkpoint substrate around F2 instead of strengthening the existing deterministic control component.

negative_evidence_and_transfer_limits.finding: Observed core dependencies include langchain-core, langgraph-checkpoint, langgraph-sdk, langgraph-prebuilt, xxhash and pydantic.
negative_evidence_and_transfer_limits.f2_consequence: For the narrow WP509 blocker, concept distillation is materially cheaper than runtime dependency adoption.

negative_evidence_and_transfer_limits.finding: The prebuilt agent can replace a budget-insufficient tool-call response with a natural-language assistant message saying more steps are needed.
negative_evidence_and_transfer_limits.f2_consequence: F2 must instead emit a typed, digest-bound EXIT/ASK/HOLD/WAIT decision; model text cannot become loop-control or completion authority.

negative_evidence_and_transfer_limits.finding: A hard step ceiling prevents infinite loops but does not by itself distinguish useful continued cognition from repeated-state rumination or premature stopping.
negative_evidence_and_transfer_limits.f2_consequence: Keep WP509 unchanged-state and epistemic-state logic; use remaining-step exposure only as an additional bounded signal, not as the sole stop policy.

patterns.name: ManagedRemainingBudgetView
patterns.shape: Pure derived read-only view of exact caller/runtime-owned budget: total_limit, consumed_steps, remaining_steps, budget_generation, budget_digest.
patterns.integration_target: WP509 snapshot construction / future runtime envelope

patterns.name: TypedPreDispatchBudgetGate
patterns.shape: Before an expensive model/tool/effect-candidate stage, deterministically reject or reroute when the exact remaining budget cannot accommodate the next bounded step; emit ASK/WAIT/DEFER_HOLD/OBSERVE rather than text fallback.

patterns.name: ResumableDrainTransition
patterns.shape: Represent shutdown/resource-pressure/maintenance exit as a typed HOLD/drain state bound to a resumable checkpoint/reference, separate from terminal completion and from hard-failure exhaustion.
patterns.authority: TRANSITION_ONLY; CHECKPOINT/UNIFIEDDB AUTHORITY REMAINS EXISTING F2/CANONICAL PATH
patterns.integration_target: WP509 + persistence/reentry layer; no second checkpointer

do_not_adopt: LangGraph graph runtime as a second control plane
LangGraph checkpoint/store as a second canonical state substrate
natural-language budget exhaustion messages as control state
GraphRecursionError semantics as proof of rumination or task completion

hypothesis.statement: WP509 can become more resource-efficient and more resumable by distilling LangGraph's runtime-managed remaining-step view and cooperative-drain separation into F2-native typed metadata, while retaining WP509's stronger unchanged-state/epistemic-state logic and canonical authority fences.
hypothesis.expected_gain: Reduce self-estimated budget drift and avoid destructive hard-stop behavior with negligible dependency cost; preserve explicit ASK/HOLD/WAIT/OBSERVE exits.

counterhypotheses.statement: WP509's existing remaining_work_units plus max_iterations is already sufficient; a separate managed remaining-step view adds duplicate fields and binding complexity without reducing errors.
counterhypotheses.discriminator: At E2/E3, construct stale/mismatched budget-generation fixtures. If the existing snapshot can already reject all stale/misaligned budget cases with equal clarity and fewer fields, reject ManagedRemainingBudgetView.

counterhypotheses.statement: Resumable drain belongs entirely in persistence/runtime orchestration, not WP509, and adding it to the rumination contract would blur responsibilities.
counterhypotheses.discriminator: Map the current reentry/checkpoint boundary. Keep WP509 limited to a typed DEFER_HOLD reason if a dedicated runtime layer can bind checkpoint/resume identity without adding a second authority.

counterhypotheses.statement: Pre-dispatch budget gating can prematurely suppress a high-value final action when budget accounting is too conservative.
counterhypotheses.discriminator: Use deterministic boundary fixtures where exactly-one-step completion-candidate work remains; require the gate to distinguish bounded next-step cost classes and route uncertainty to ASK/HOLD rather than silently dropping work.

recommended_next_trigger6_objective.task: Map ManagedRemainingBudgetView, TypedPreDispatchBudgetGate and ResumableDrainTransition against exact current WP509/WP505/reentry interfaces. Prove that the mapping adds no second state/checkpoint/effect authority and identify the smallest exact ABI delta or reject it as redundant.
